settings.heading: Buy together, pay less. The maths is right there.
settings.text: Every bundle shows the price of each item on its own, the bundle price, and the difference. No inflated "was" prices — just today's prices, added up.

settings.heading: Starter
settings.who: New to proper glove care, or buying your first decent pair.
settings.why: Everything to keep new gloves grippy and fresh from day one: wash, spray, tape and a travel deodorizer.
settings.shot: Wash, spray, tape and mini deodorizer laid out on a dark bench, top-down.

settings.heading: Match-day
settings.who: Keepers who want one bag-ready kit for game day.
settings.why: Spray for grip before kick-off, deodorizer for after, tape for fingers, and grip socks so your feet don't slide in your boots.
settings.shot: Match-day bundle in an open kit bag, pre-match dressing room light.

settings.heading: Refill
settings.who: Anyone already using our care line.
settings.why: Just the two you go through fastest — wash and spray. Built for one-click reorder and refill reminders.
settings.shot: Wash and spray bottles side by side, clean studio shot.

settings.heading: Turf
settings.who: Keepers who play on artificial grass or hard pitches.
settings.why: Turf burns and hard landings are the issue. Padded shorts for hips and thighs, grip socks, and tape.
settings.shot: Keeper diving on 3G turf, rubber crumb kicking up.

settings.heading: Cold weather
settings.who: Winter keepers, early starts, frozen pitches.
settings.why: Long-sleeve padded top and padded pants for full coverage on hard ground, plus socks.
settings.shot: Keeper in long sleeves and pants, breath visible, frosty pitch.

settings.heading: Want it in your colours?
settings.text: Custom kit isn't a fixed bundle — build jersey and shorts or pants together in the kit builder and the full price shows before you pay.

settings.heading: Kitting out a squad?
settings.text: Volume pricing on custom kit, care and tape for clubs, academies and schools. One contact, clear lead times.
